annotations.title: Look up a Hán Nôm character

description:
ALWAYS invoke this before stating any reading, meaning, or variant of a Chữ Nôm (喃) or Hán (漢) character. Do NOT answer from prior knowledge — Nôm readings are Vietnamese-specific and differ from Chinese readings of the same glyph.

Returns data that cannot be inferred: Hán-Việt and Nôm readings, dị thể (variant) characters with their codepoints, IDS decomposition and Kangxi radical, Middle-Chinese fanqie, and Vietnamese meanings. Each meaning carries the dictionary it came from and the reading it belongs to, so senses under different readings are never confused. Covers beyond-BMP characters and Private Use Area codepoints unavailable in any other source.

"historicalEntries" lists entries in historical dictionaries (e.g. Đại Nam Quấc âm tự vị, 1895) that print this character — summaries only. Pass an entryId to lookup_dictionary_entry for the original wording and its subentries.

Use for Vietnamese Hán Nôm. Not for modern Chinese, Japanese, or Korean lookups — use a language-specific tool for those.

character.description: A single Hán or Nôm character, e.g. 些 or 𡗶. Pass the character itself, not a codepoint.

name: lookup_character

historicalEntries.description: Canonical entries from historical dictionaries that print this glyph. Summaries only — call lookup_dictionary_entry with an entryId for the full entry and its subentries.

citationCount.description: How many attested citations sit under those senses.

definition.description: May be empty — 545 entries carry their sense only in subentries.

entryId.description: Unique WITHIN this work only, e.g. "B-0123". Always pass it together with workKey.

han.description: The headword's Hán/Nôm form, or null when there is none. One codepoint in character dictionaries; in word-level works (ntqatd) it can be a whole word such as 別咍, so do not treat it as a single character.

hanStatus.description: "unicode" | "pua" | "image_only" | "none" (the work prints no glyph for this headword).

orderInWork.description: Position in the WHOLE work, 0-based across every section — not a position within the section. B-0123 is 196 because 74 entries precede letter B. It equals globalId minus one: the same count, not a different basis. Use it for ordering only; cite entryId to identify an entry.

senseCount.description: How many numbered senses this entry has. Zero for works that print subentries instead.

sourceLetter.description: The printed alphabetical SECTION this entry sits in — not the headword's own first letter. The tail of a section can spill into the next word, so "Cạ" is filed under "B". Never infer the headword's spelling from it.

sourcePage.description: Page of the scanned volume this entry is printed on. Cite it as a page number.

subentryCount.description: How many subentries this entry HAS. None of them are included here — call lookup_dictionary_entry with entryId to read them.

typeMarker.description: The printed marker verbatim: "n." means nôm (script origin), NOT noun.

workKey.description: Stable key of the work, e.g. "dnqatv". Pass it back as `work`.

workTitle.description: The work's title as it prints it — "Quấc", not the modern "Quốc".

entryRef.description: Present only when this definition maps unambiguously to one canonical historical entry. Pass it to lookup_dictionary_entry.

entryId.description: Entry id within that work, e.g. "B-0123".

reading.description: The reading this sense is filed under, when known.

source.description: Internal source key, e.g. "dnqatv". Null means the row predates source tracking — report the definition as unattributed, never guess which dictionary it came from.

title: Look up a Hán Nôm character
